# okstatus_monitors (Data Source)

Every monitor already configured in the org that owns the configured API key — read-only, useful to check what exists before adding more (e.g. `data.okstatus_monitors.all.total`, or `length(data.okstatus_monitors.all.monitors)`). Pages through `GET /monitors` internally, so `total`/`monitors` reflect the full set regardless of the API's per-request page cap.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "okstatus_monitors" "all" {}

output "monitor_count" {
  value = data.okstatus_monitors.all.total
}

output "monitor_names" {
  value = [for m in data.okstatus_monitors.all.monitors : m.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier — this data source has no single ID of its own, required by the Terraform plugin framework.
- `monitors` (Attributes List) One entry per monitor. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--monitors))
- `total` (Number) Number of monitors currently configured in the org.
